entities.summary: Yngve Axel Andreas Larsson was a Swedish pediatrician, medicine professor and diabetologist. He worked for the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency in Addis Abeba, Ethiopia. Later he worked in Linköping, Sweden, where he was in charge of diabetology at Linköping University. Larsson was a member of the Advisory Council for the International Society for Pediatric and Adolescent Diabetes, and worked for several years for the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare.
